comment: Master re-run campaign ledger v3. One batch = one night. Run: python src/run_all.py --batch N1. Batches follow the paper: production ensembles (N1-N3), protocol-robustness axes (N4-N5), then the supplementary validations in section and table order (N6-N10).

N1.comment: 316SS production configuration: coupled inversion at the full digitized extent (L = 80 um), eleven seeds.

N2.comment: Hastelloy-N production configurations: coupled and EDS-only, eleven seeds each.

N3.comment: 316H production configurations: coupled, EDS-only, and the alpha0 = -1 initialization control (three seeds).

N4.comment: Mass-anchor weight sweep for 316SS (w_mass = 20/30/40; the production level 10 is the N1 configuration). Consistent-regime arm: establishes that the reported 316SS values are insensitive to the weight.

N5.comment: Deficit-regime variants, two axes: mass-anchor weight 20 for Hastelloy-N and 316H (the violation total is the weight-invariant quantity, Section 4.3), and the averaged-anchor form for 316H (anchor-form axis).

jobs.comment: dW_data is the mean of the two same-time gravimetric replicates, (7.66 + 4.12)/2 / 1.85 mg/cm^2, fed as a single anchor at the single measurement time (n_mass = 1), expressed as exact float64 values.

N6.comment: Section S3 validation under the production protocol: 316SS coupled inversion with a single gravimetric anchor (the 3000 h audit-convention value, 0.547 mg/cm^2) in lieu of the six-point series - the Hastelloy-N-like data structure. Establishes whether reducing the mass constraint to one time point biases the fitted parameters.

N7.comment: Synthetic verification (Section S4, reduced design): four-quadrant sign recovery against known ground truth, and the mass-inflation sweep locating the alpha sign-flip threshold. Three seeds per configuration.

N8.comment: Domain-size and outlier characterization, eleven seeds per configuration (Section S5): full-extent domains for Hastelloy-N (70 um) and 316H (50 um), reduced domain for 316SS (40 um), and the outlier-inclusion variant for 316H.

N9.comment: Two-basis quadratic-closure study for 316SS (Section S6, Tables S10-S11): eleven seeds trained directly in the endpoint-curvature chart, and an eleven-seed control trained from the identical starting function in a standard polynomial expansion. Establishes that the range-averaged magnitude is closure-robust while the individual endpoints and the curvature are not, and supplies the beta comparison (about fivefold in the polynomial basis, about twelvefold in the physical basis).

N10.comment: Quadratic-closure probes, EDS-only, all three alloys (Section S6, Tables S12-S14): regenerates the pre-reform inherited exhibits as a current-generation campaign. Three seeds per alloy, matching the three-seed EDS-only probes of the run inventory in Section 3.4.

N11.comment: 316SS EDS-only linear ensemble (eleven seeds): the anchor-free counterpart of the production campaign. Establishes whether the mass anchor biases the 316SS coupled estimate, independently of the audit.
